title: Baxter Healthcare Corporation — Warning Letter (Drugs/CDER)
ai_summary: FDA 웹페이지 본문 기준으로, 2026-09-29자 CDER Warning Letter는 Baxter Healthcare Round Lake 시설(2026.3.23~4.2 실사)에서 세팔로스포린과 다른 주사제 간 교차오염 방지를 위한 분리 미흡 및 환경모니터링 미흡, 무균공정 밸리데이션·공기흐름·환경모니터링 미흡, 수동 육안검사 운영자 적격성 미흡, 누출 및 무균성 시험 실패 조사 미흡을 CGMP 위반으로 지적했다. 업체 회신(2026-04-23)도 부적절하다고 평가했다. 연결된 페이지 본문만 검토한 것이며 첨부는 포함되지 않는다.

summary_review.method: 근거 인용 자동 일치 검사 · 독립 검수 아님
summary_review.scope: 공식 링크에서 추출한 본문과 근거 인용을 자동 대조했습니다. 문서 전체의 사람 검수를 뜻하지 않습니다.

evidence.quote: facility. 1. Your firm failed to perform operations within specifically defined areas of adequate size and to have separate or defined areas or such other control systems necessary to prevent contamination or mix-ups (21 CFR 211.42(c)). You manufacture various injectable drugs products including cephalosporins (a beta-lactam drug product) and (b)(4) drug products at your facility. You failed to ensure complete and comprehensive separation of cephalosporin and (b)(4) drug products in this shared facility. Lack of Complete and Comprehensive Separation Your facilities and controls were inadequat

efined areas or such other control systems necessary to prevent contamination or mix-ups in aseptic processing areas (21 CFR 211.42(c)(10)). You operate (b)(4) processing lines used to aseptically manufacture sterile injectable drug products for the U.S. market. Your (b)(4) were inadequately validated to ensure that they were capable of consistently (b)(4) interior surfaces of your (b)(4) lines in preparation for aseptic production. In addition, your aseptic process simulations did not sufficiently represent worst-case conditions, and you lacked adequate sampling of your ISO 5 (Grade A) area.
